channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em Nova Iguaçu (RJ), Flávio volta a atribuir endividamento a Lula e repete aceno a mulheres
item.description: In Nova Iguaçu (RJ), presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) repeated his pledge to combat household debt and maintain the Bolsa Família program in a potential government. He once again criticized the PT, blaming President Lula for family indebtedness and claiming Brazil must defeat the PT to avoid being defeated itself.

item.title: Debate sobre fim da escala 6x1 é 'populista e inócuo', diz coordenadora econômica de Flávio
item.description: Daniella Marques, coordinator of the economic agenda for Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) government plan, called the debate over ending the 6x1 work scale 'populist' and 'ineffective.' She advocated for greater freedom for workers and employers to negotiate work schedules.

item.title: Sob Duda Lima, Flávio Bolsonaro afina discurso e encontra rumo para sua campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro restructures his presidential campaign with three pillars defined by Duda Lima: legitimate heir of anti-PT sentiment, "necessary evil" for center-right to defeat Lula, and ethical attacks on the PT government. The strategy aims to counter Gilberto Kassab's assessment that he would be a weak second-round candidate.

item.title: Entre os vazamentos e as respostas, o dilema da campanha de Lula com Lulinha
item.description: Lula's campaign now treats the Lulinha case as an electoral variable, not just a legal one. Successive leaks create a damaging narrative faster than the official investigation can respond, and Lula defends both investigating the leak sources and having his son testify to the Federal Police. The opposition is already using the issue to request a Congressional Inquiry Committee (CPMI).

item.title: Flávio quer rediscutir gasolina com 32% de etanol
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he intends to renegotiate the mandatory 32% ethanol blend in gasoline, criticizing the recently approved measure by the CNPE due to potential engine damage and lack of durability testing. He compared the increase in ethanol content to the practice of reducing product sizes without price changes, claiming the government is 'not even sparing fuel.' The blend increase was established by the Fuel of the Future Law, signed in October 2024.

item.title: Lobista planejava tirar Lulinha do país no início de 2025
item.description: Investigations reveal that lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger planned to help Lulinha leave Brazil in January 2025, before the INSS scandal, to advance a R$1 billion-plus cannabidiol medication deal with Careca do INSS. Lulinha moved to Madrid in June 2025, two months after the massive INSS fraud erupted, living in a luxury condo rented for about €5,000. The Federal Police is investigating influence peddling by the pair within the Ministry of Health.

item.title: Mendonça manda PF investigar vazamentos do caso Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate the leaks and breaches of evidence custody in the investigations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, the eldest son of President Lula. The decision was issued on Thursday (August 20, 2026) and aims to determine responsibility for the leaks in the case.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha celebra decisão do STF, mas vê prejuízo consolidado
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, celebrated the decision by Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça ordering the Federal Police to investigate the leak of confidential data regarding the businessman. Lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho welcomed the opening of inquiries to probe the selective and out-of-context disclosure of the audio recordings, but lamented that the damage to his client's image is already consolidated. Mendonça ordered the identification of those who had access to the confidential material, preserving secrecy and ruling out investigations against journalists.

item.title: Questão sobre grávida morta pelo ex gera revolta em concurso do MPSP
item.description: Candidates for the MPSP job exam protested the classification of a case in which a pregnant woman was killed by her ex-boyfriend as qualified homicide rather than femicide. The exam board justified the decision, arguing there was no indication of gender-based prejudice, but the answer key was challenged by roughly 150 applicants. The case sparked debate over the proper application of the femicide statute in Brazilian law.

item.title: Passados 30 dias de ordem de Moraes, defesa de Bolsonaro informa ao STF que retomará agendamento de visitas 'gerais'
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense team announced to the STF that general visits to the former president will resume after the 30-day ban imposed by Minister Moraes expired. Medical, physiotherapy, and legal team visits were already allowed, but politically motivated visits remain prohibited until the end of the 2026 elections.

item.title: 'Quem são os candidatos': g1 lança ferramenta com dados oficiais de candidaturas e campanhas
item.description: g1 launched the 'Quem são os candidatos' tool, which aggregates official TSE data on candidacies and campaigns for the 2026 elections. The platform allows searches by name, party, gender, occupation, and other filters, and displays detailed information about each politician, including declared assets and campaign finances.

item.title: Relação com Trump: Brasil quer evitar nova escalada na crise diplomática
item.description: The Lula administration maintains a conciliatory stance toward Trump, prioritizing avoiding renewed diplomatic crisis and pursuing a pragmatic relationship without requiring political alignment.

item.title: Mendonça determina investigação contra vazamentos no caso Lulinha
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate leaks of confidential information from the inquiries involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, following a request from the defense. The investigation will proceed as part of an ongoing inquiry related to the Operation Without Discount, which examines fraud at the INSS, targeting non-journalists who disclosed protected data.

item.title: Comissão do governo Lula garante bolada de R$ 100 mil a ex-deputado do PT
item.description: The Lula government's Amnesty Commission recognized Vicentinho, former PT lawmaker, as a political amnestee and granted him R$100,000 in a one-time payment, after overturning a decision made under the Bolsonaro administration. The ruling, issued in May, also annulled rejections for eight other applicants and included an official apology for persecution during the dictatorship. Changes in the commission's composition under the previous government had led to the rejection of many amnesty requests.

item.title: Atuação de Lulinha em negociações com governo foi encoberta por amiga lobista e ‘Careca do INSS’, diz PF
item.description: Federal police are investigating alleged irregular negotiations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, aided by lobbyist friend Roberta Luchsinger and the 'Bald INSS' lobbyist. Messages suggest Lulinha's involvement was concealed to secure contracts in the Ministry of Health and other public agencies.

item.title: Tarciana Medeiros enfrenta pressão interna no Banco do Brasil
item.description: Tarciana Medeiros, president of Banco do Brasil, faces internal pressure following criticism over agricultural risk management. Allies label the accusations as 'gossip' in an election year. Internal divisions emerge regarding her leadership.

item.title: Mendonça manda PF apurar vazamentos envolvendo Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate leaks of information related to investigations against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula. The businessman is under three inquiries for suspected influence trafficking. The decision aims to investigate irregularities in the disclosure of sensitive data about the case.

item.title: Mendonça determina investigação sobre 'vazamento' de informações em caso que apura suspeita de tráfico de influência de Lulinha
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered an investigation into the leak of information in the case investigating suspected influence peddling by businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha. The decision responds to a request from the defense of the president's son and targets those responsible for the leak, not journalists.

item.title: TSE define tempo de TV dos candidatos a presidente; veja o tempo de cada um
item.description: The TSE set TV time allocation for presidential candidates for free electoral advertising, based on party representation in the Chamber of Deputies. Lula leads with 5 minutes and 31 seconds, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 4 minutes and 20 seconds. Broadcasting starts August 28th, with display order determined by lottery.

item.title: Mendonça manda PF investigar vazamento no caso Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate leaks of confidential information involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Lula. The decision expands an existing investigation into leaks related to the 'Sem Desconto' Operation and the Metrópoles reports. Justice Mendonça emphasized that journalists will not be investigated and source confidentiality must be preserved.

item.title: Mendonça determina investigação sobre suspeita de novos vazamentos em caso de Lulinha
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered an investigation into suspected leaks of confidential data involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, in the influencer trading and Operation No Discount cases. The probe will target those with a duty to preserve secrecy, not journalists.

item.title: Arena Cross Brasil 2026 define campeões nas quatro categorias
item.description: The 2026 Arena Cross Brasil season concluded with the Super Final at Interlagos, crowning champions in PRO (Enzo Lopes), AX2 (Gabi Andrigo), 65 cc (Lorenzo Ricken), and 50 cc (Tomas Aguila), with strong international participation in the decisive races.

item.title: Mendonça manda PF investigar novamente vazamento de inquérito sobre Lulinha
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered the Federal Police to investigate another data leak from the inquiry involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, emphasizing the preservation of journalistic source confidentiality and focusing the investigation on those responsible for leaking sealed information. The decision responds to a request from Lulinha's defense team, which included press reports containing messages exchanged with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger.

item.title: Senadores que não disputarão eleições e deixarão a Casa em 2027 são 13
item.description: 13 senators holding the 54 seats up for election in 2026 are not running for any position and will leave the Senate in 2027. Additionally, 9 senators are participating in the elections but running for other positions or as alternates, while 32 are seeking reelection. At least 22 current incumbents will not be in the Senate after 2027, with the number potentially increasing depending on election outcomes.

item.title: Brasil tem candidatos nascidos na China, Bolívia, Síria e mais países nestas eleições
item.description: For the 2026 elections, the TSE received 24 registrations of candidates born abroad and self-declared as naturalized Brazilians, including origins from Syria, Bolivia, China, Italy, and the United States. Most of these applications still need to be reviewed by the Electoral Justice to verify document regularity and compliance with legal requirements. Some cases, such as that of an alleged Portuguese naturalized candidate, may involve errors in form filling.

item.title: Mendonça determina remoção de vídeo feito por IA com Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered the immediate removal of an AI-generated video featuring Flávio Bolsonaro alongside Daniel Vorcaro, classifying it as a deepfake and threatening Meta with fines for non-compliance. The video, posted on August 14, depicts simulated scenes of money exchanges and may mislead voters during the electoral process. Flávio is under investigation for allegedly receiving funds from Vorcaro for the production of the film Dark Horse.

item.title: TSE define tempo da propaganda eleitoral na TV; veja quantos minutos cada candidato vai ter
item.description: The TSE defined the distribution of free electoral advertising time on TV and radio for the 2026 presidential elections. The largest share was granted to the Brasil Pronto para Mais coalition (Lula), followed by PL (Flávio Bolsonaro). The division considers party representation in the Chamber of Deputies and the performance clause.

item.title: Datafolha divulga nesta sexta nova pesquisa sobre a eleição presidencial; veja horário e detalhes
item.description: Datafolha will release a new presidential polling survey this Friday (21), conducted with 2,058 voters between Tuesday and Thursday, with a margin of error of two percentage points. In the latest round from July 24, Lula led the first round with 40% versus 32% for Flávio Bolsonaro, and won the projected runoff with 48% to 43%.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Mendonça deve manter inquéritos contra Lulinha no STF; leia bastidores
item.description: Minister André Mendonça is expected to keep the investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva at the Supreme Federal Court, despite the Attorney General's Office requesting transfer to the first instance. The probes investigate alleged influence peddling and have support from the 2nd Chamber in case of appeal. The case remains a sensitive issue in the political landscape.

item.title: Poder Entrevista: Delúbio Soares, ex-tesoureiro do PT
item.description: Delúbio Soares, former PT treasurer convicted in Mensalão and Lava Jato, is interviewed by Poder360 on August 21, 2026, ahead of running for federal deputy in Goiás. His path involves corruption, imprisonment, pardon and annulled convictions, reflecting the troubled history of PT. In 2026, he returns to politics from Goiás, contributing to reshape the party's image in the elections.

item.title: Durigan diz que fim da 6 X 1 e juros serão foco em eventual reeleição
item.description: Durigan emphasized that ending the 6 X 1 scale and tackling high interest rates will be priorities in a potential new Lula term. He also warned about the impact of geopolitical conflicts on inflation and the Brazilian economy.

item.title: Crusoé: Menções a Lulinha dominam repercussão digital do escândalo do INSS
item.description: References to businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, account for 31.4% of digital backlash surrounding the INSS scandal in 2026, according to a Bites consultancy poll. The case involves embezzlement and improper discounts in INSS pensions and retirements, becoming a central campaign issue. Mentions of the president's son amplify perceptions of nepotism and corruption among the digital middle class.

item.title: O Romero Britto da discórdia no caminho de Caiado
item.description: Paulo Vasconcelos, campaign strategist for Ronaldo Caiado, criticized the new campaign logo, comparing it to a Romero Britto artwork and asserting it fails to reflect the image of a fighter against organized crime. Vasconcelos' dissatisfaction, already rooted in disagreements with Caiado's stance toward Flávio Bolsonaro, led to his withdrawal from the marketing team. The incident underscores internal tensions within the PSD-GO presidential campaign.

item.title: O mito do governo técnico
item.description: The text examines the myth of the technical government in Brazilian politics, showing how the idea that specialists and impartial bureaucracy would solve the country's problems is a narrative repeated since the Estado Novo. It questions this logic by demonstrating that such promises historically become a set of repeated formulas, without overcoming the deep structures of the Brazilian State.

item.title: Nenhuma medida foi aprovada sem responsabilidade fiscal, diz Durigan
item.description: Minister of Finance Dário Durigan stated in an interview with Rádio Metrópoles da Bahia that no measure under President Lula has been approved without fiscal responsibility, contrasting it with the previous administration. He criticized what he deemed irresponsible policies under Jair Bolsonaro and emphasized balancing fiscal discipline with social programs.

item.title: A conversa a de Lula com quatro ministros do STF regada a uísque
item.description: About a month ago, President Lula held an informal, whiskey-fueled conversation with four Supreme Federal Court justices. The full report is exclusive to subscribers and covers an informal dialogue between the head of the Executive and Supreme Court justices. The meeting underscores inter-branch dialogue, though specific discussion topics are not disclosed in the preview.

item.title: Datafolha divulga nesta sexta-feira primeira pesquisa da eleição presidencial após início da campanha
item.description: Datafolha will release the first electoral poll of the presidential campaign on Friday, surveying 2,058 respondents with a margin of error of two percentage points. The poll includes first-round and four second-round simulations among the 13 candidates registered with the TSE, commissioned by Globo and Folha de S.Paulo.

item.title: PF chegou em Lulinha e STF continua como tribunal geral da República?
item.description: The STF expanded its role beyond the judicial sphere, assuming a political role and becoming the apex of the Brazilian legal system. During the pandemic and after January 8th, the court acted to limit abuses and guarantee minority rights.

item.title: Aliados de Lula comemoram vazamentos na íntegra sobre Lulinha
item.description: Lula's allies celebrated the full leak of the PF report on Lulinha and Marcola's ties to lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, betting that full disclosure will avoid further scandals during the campaign. They also welcomed the PGR statement that does not confirm any deal between the government and the so-called Careca do INSS, helping to contextualize the case.

item.title: Defesa da amiga de Lulinha pede paralisação do inquérito a Mendonça
item.description: The defense of lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, requested the suspension of the Supreme Court investigation into alleged influence peddling in the Lula administration. The lawyers claimed irregularities in the evidence gathered during the probe.

item.title: Mendonça tende a manter no STF inquéritos sobre Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça is likely to keep the inquiries into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and a lobbyist at the STF, rejecting the transfer requested by the PGR, as messages mention authorities with privileged jurisdiction. The decision follows criticism of the PGR and PF's handling of the investigation.

item.title: Vice de Flávio, Alfredo Gaspar terá papel estratégico na propaganda eleitoral
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, was selected as a presenter for campaign ads in Northeast Brazil, focusing on critiques of the Lula government. The strategy aims to leverage his regional image to counter Lula's support in the region.

item.title: Douglas Souza: ‘o vôlei não é tão inclusivo quanto as pessoas acham’
item.description: Douglas Souza, 30, returns to the Brazilian volleyball team after five years away, driven by his Olympic aspirations and personal growth. He married streamer Gabriel Campos in 2026 and discusses discrimination in sports and inclusion.

item.title: Durigan diz que enfoque em eventual novo mandato de Lula será fim da 6 x 1 e redução de juros
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated that, in a potential new term for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, priorities would include ending the 6x1 scale and reducing interest rates. He highlighted these as economic focuses for the coming years.

item.title: Quartas de final da Sul-Americana: veja o chaveamento e as datas dos confrontos
item.description: The 2026 Copa Sudamericana advances to the quarterfinals with four Brazilian clubs: São Paulo, Santos, Atlético-MG, and Vasco. The matchups are set, highlighted by São Paulo vs. Boca Juniors and Atlético-MG vs. Santos, while Vasco awaits River Plate or Independiente Santa Fe. The tournament represents a chance at a title and a spot in the 2027 Libertadores.

item.title: Mansão usada por Lulinha foi alugada por testemunha da Lava Jato
item.description: Federal Police investigate the rental of a mansion in Brasília, allegedly hired for Fábio Luís da Silva, known as Lulinha, with documents signed by Rafael Nicolau Arbex. The investigation is linked to three inquiries at the Supreme Court, including suspected influence peddling and corruption in the INSS. Roberta Luchsinger, who rented the property, was a witness in the Car Wash operation.

item.title: O elo entre a mansão usada por Lulinha e o sítio de Atibaia
item.description: Dentist Rafael Nicolau Arbex, a Lava Jato witness, appears as a link between the mansion used by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and the Atibaia site tied to a conviction of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The investigation gathers corruption elements involving relatives and political allies.

item.title: 'Fora da bolha': Lulinha nas manchetes, picanha e bets na campanha e o factoide de Marçal
item.description: The third episode of 'Fora da Bolha' discusses investigations involving Lula's son and a lobbyist, creating pressure on the PT campaign for re-election. The video also covers the disagreement between PGR and STF regarding jurisdiction, along with topics like cost of living, debt, online betting, and Pablo Marçal's entry into the presidential race. Analysts comment on electoral strategies and the impact of these factors on the crystallized electorate.

item.title: Lula anuncia investimentos de R$ 2,3 bilhões em inteligência artificial
item.description: President Lula announced R$ 2.3 billion in AI investments, including a supercomputer, Chinese tech partnerships, and chip development. The initiative aims to boost Brazil's technological autonomy and train 3,000 professionals.

item.title: Zema defende tarifa mínima para motoboys e cobra respeito de aplicativos
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) defended on Thursday (20th) the creation of a minimum fare for motorcycle courier delivery workers, emphasizing the need for respect and protection of workers. He highlighted that delivery personnel need to be valued and institutionalized with a guaranteed minimum fare.
